data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Quddusiyyah" translates to "the one who is protected by God." This name holds significant cultural importance within the Muslim community, as it reflects the belief in the protective care and guidance of Allah (God) in the lives of believers. It is a reminder that no matter what challenges or difficulties a person may face in life, they are never alone in their struggles, as they are constantly being protected and cared for by the Almighty.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Quddusiyyah" carries deep spiritual significance, as it emphasizes the importance of relying on Allah for protection and guidance instead of relying on oneself or material possessions. It is a reminder of the ultimate reality of divine love and protection, and the belief that true security and safety come from submitting to the will of God. By embracing this name, a person is constantly reminded to seek refuge in Allah and to trust in His infinite mercy and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protected by God" symbolizes She who is protected by the All-Mighty and Merciful God. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Quddusiyyah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protected by god.
